pli-tv-pvr2.8:1.1: avassutā bhikkhunī avassutassa purisapuggalassa kāyasaṃsaggaṃ sādiyantī kati āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.8:2.1: tā āpattiyo catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ kati vipattiyo bhajanti,
pli-tv-pvr2.8:3.1: dadhiṃ viññāpetvā bhuñjantī kati āpattiyo āpajjati.
pli-tv-pvr2.8:3.2: dadhiṃ v. bh. dve āp. āp.,
pli-tv-pvr2.8:4.1: tā āpattiyo catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ kati vipattiyo bhajanti . . .
pli-tv-pvr2.8:4.6: tā āpattiyo catunnaṃ vipattīnaṃ ekaṃ vipattiṃ bhajanti
pli-tv-pvr2.8:4.11: siyā kāyato samuṭṭhanti na vācato na cittato,
pli-tv-pvr2.8:4.12: siyā kāyato ca vācato ca samuṭṭhanti na cittato,
pli-tv-pvr2.8:4.13: siyā kāyato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhanti na vācato,
pli-tv-pvr2.8:4.14: siyā kāyato ca vācato ca cittato ca samuṭṭhanti,
pli-tv-pvr2.8:4.17: tiṇavatthārakena ca. samuccayavāraṃ niṭṭhitaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ. ||8|| yan
